officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Siliguri Jalpaiguri Development Authority page indexes RS mouza maps under Matigara and Naxalbari blocks of the Siliguri subdivision for land-use/development-permission applicants. The page expressly labels the information privileged and restricts copying/distribution; no maps were accessed or retained.
West Bengal UDMA documents a Know Your Property/encumbrance service requiring OTP registration, then district, block/BLLRO, mouza and plot or khatian selection; not an anonymous geometry service.

Siliguri Municipal Corporation lists local holding mutation and property assessment services and document requirements; this is municipal assessment/administration, not proof of cadastral vector coverage.
Official SJDA describes its statutory planning role in the Siliguri-Jalpaiguri planning area.
